dialogues.speaker: Herne
dialogues.text: *sigh* Yeah, it's supposed to bring a letter from him.

dialogues.speaker: Herne
dialogues.text: I wrote to him earlier, asking whether I should try adventuring in Natlan. He should've replied by now, but I still haven't heard back...

dialogues.speaker: Herne
dialogues.text: Um, maybe that's a hint? Maybe Uncle Draff was trying to say that even pigeons can go missing on the way, so there's no hope for a young, inexperienced person like myself...
